entities.summary: Alexandra Papadopoulou was a Greek short story writer, columnist, teacher and publicist. She is recognized as the first Greek prose writer, with some feminist ideas. She was also a pioneer Greek publisher of literary publications, as a woman in a profession dominated by men.
